requirements.statement: An employee can submit an expense claim with amount, category, date, and description

criteria.must: An employee can create a claim by entering an amount, category, date, and description
A newly submitted claim has status pending
The category must be one of the fixed list (Travel, Meals, Lodging, Supplies, Other)

requirements.statement: An employee can attach a receipt image to their claim

criteria.must: An employee can attach a receipt image when submitting a claim
A claim can be submitted without a receipt attachment
An attached receipt can be viewed later from the claim

requirements.statement: An employee can see the status of all their claims

criteria.must: An employee sees a list of all claims they submitted
Each listed claim shows its current status (pending, approved, or rejected)
An employee cannot see another employee's claims

requirements.statement: An employee can edit and resubmit a claim their manager rejected

criteria.must: A rejected claim can be edited by the employee who submitted it
Resubmitting an edited claim sets its status back to pending
A claim that is not rejected cannot be resubmitted

requirements.statement: A manager can see the pending claims submitted by their direct reports

criteria.must: A manager sees a list of pending claims submitted by their direct reports
A manager does not see pending claims from employees who are not their direct reports

requirements.statement: A manager can approve or reject a claim, optionally with a comment

criteria.must: A manager can approve a pending claim
A manager can reject a pending claim
A manager can add a comment when approving or rejecting
The employee can see the manager's decision and comment on their claim

requirements.statement: A finance user can see all approved claims awaiting export

criteria.must: A finance user sees a list of approved claims that have not yet been exported
A previously exported claim no longer appears in the awaiting-export list

requirements.statement: A finance user can export approved claims to payroll

criteria.must: A finance user can trigger an export of approved claims
The export produces a downloadable file containing the exported claims' data

requirements.statement: Exported claims are marked so they are never sent to payroll twice

criteria.must: A claim included in an export is marked as exported
An already-exported claim cannot be exported again
